dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: Not to brag, but I can tell everything about you just from one good look at your face! Your future fortunes, and also whether you're a good or bad person!

dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: These days I do face readings for passers-by, free of charge. So how about it, shall I do you now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, let's give it a go.

dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: Awesome! Let me have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: Hmm... Smooth forehead, square jaw, symmetrical features, beautiful eyes, healthy complexion...

dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: How strange... you've gone a little red in the face...

response.speaker: Fugui
response.text: ...Speaks from the diaphragm, perfect enunciation... You seem pure of heart to me. You're a good egg!

response.speaker: Fugui
response.text: ...And I can see that fate possibly has an enormous sum of money in store for you, but currently you're on track to miss out on it by a hair's breadth.

response.speaker: Fugui
response.text: So, don't chase after fleeting pleasures. Pull your finger out, knuckle down, and work hard. Your future will reward you for it. Got it?

choices.text: Took a blow to the face in a fight just now...

response.speaker: Fugui
response.text: ...Bit too symmetrical for a blow to the face if you ask me... but on the whole you don't seem like the bad type...

response.speaker: Fugui
response.text: ...And I can see that fate has a calamity coming your way, but as long as you work hard, keep doing the right thing, things'll work out for you in the end.

response.speaker: Fugui
response.text: So, don't set your sights too high, take opportunities when they come your way, and while you might not be destined for great success you'll have a happy and secure life ahead of you. Got it?
